templates.why_chosen: Named in the reference as the three-panels/one-varying-mechanism exemplar: identical SM-roster-to-Tile-to-RS layout stacked as three wide rows, changing only which hardware resource, copy engine, specialized SM, or co-located SM, drives communication.
templates.what_to_learn: Stack comparison panels as full-width rows, not side-by-side columns, when each panel is itself a wide strip, and keep the tile-to-signal-to-RS-unit layout pixel-identical across rows so only the swapped hardware resource (copy engine, specialized SM, co-located SM) catches the eye.
